jobs.occupation: Internal Control (Senior) Associate (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
About CF Assurance (CF A)
Our mission at Controlling and
Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent
foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of
the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our
expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an
inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop
professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious,
humble and open – define how we work together as a department.
To deliver on our vision of
being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a
unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong
learning and encourage our people towards continuous upskilling as a natural
part of their career. This is your chance to build your network within the
company and become part of a diverse, international and innovative team.
About CF A Internal Control (IC)
CF A Internal Control (IC) is
the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.
We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a
state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with
corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally
harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.
As Siemens transforms
into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.
We are looking for a
dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.
Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.
What You'll Do:

- Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI): Ideate, design, and
implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You
will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control
effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.
- Shape the Future of Internal Controls Methodology: Be part of the team responsible for the
effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.
- Own and Evolve the IC Framework: Take responsibility
for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.
- Enable and Empower the Global IC Community: Coach ICS
professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control
system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and
emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.
- Develop and Deliver Training & Guidance: Create and deliver
Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to
support the global rollout of methodologies and tools, fostering a culture
of continuous learning and excellence.
- Collaborate with the External Auditor: Align and discuss
Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to
ensure compliance and best-practice alignment.
- Keep Management informed: Understand global
patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.
- Contribute Beyond IC: Engage with the
broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":

- Strong Academic Foundation: Degree in business
administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally
a master’s degree.
- Proven IC & IT Controls Expertise: Extensive professional experience in Internal Control (including ICFR) with
a focus on IT controls. You understand the role IT systems
like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT
Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls
(ITGCs).
- Passion for Innovation & GenAI: Strong interest and
ideally hands-on experience in Generative AI and its
application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and
pilot GenAI use cases that drive automation, intelligence, and efficiency
in internal controls and risk management.
- Curiosity for other relevant Technologies: Genuine interest in
topics like RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML, and their potential
benefits and challenges in ICFR and ICSR environments. You stay current
with technological trends and are eager to experiment and learn.
- Growth Mindset: You enjoy taking on
new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are
comfortable pioneering new approaches.
- International & Intercultural Experience: Work experience in
an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a
strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
- Adaptability & Results Orientation: You impress with
your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus
on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
- Excellent Communication Skills: Strong
communication skills in German and English (written and
spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
- Digital Proficiency: Very good MS Office skills and comfort working with digital tools and
platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new
technologies is essential.

Why Join Us?

- Contribute to strategic initiatives around GenAI, digital business, and innovation in the context of internal controls.
- Work at the intersection of governance, technology, and innovation, shaping the future of internal controls in
a global technology leader.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge
technologies like GenAI, and the chance to grow your career across
Siemens.
- Join a diverse, international, and inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold
thinking.

Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Associate (f/m/d) – Internal Audit – Regulatory and Technology Assurance Lead Siemens Bank (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
**Accelerate your career.**Our mission at Controlling and Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of the company. As a business partner to Siemens’ management, we apply our expertise in a wide range of topics to create organizational impact. Collaborative ecosystems help create and use innovative methods for better assurance. We offer an inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop professionally and personally. Our core values, being respectful, curious, humble and open, define how we work together as a department.
As Siemens is creating technology to transform the everyday for everyone, the Technology & Financial Audit Practice plays a pivotal role in providing assurance to the Managing Board and the Audit Committee. We cover a wide range of technology and finance-related global audit topics such as assurance over entire digital ecosystems, AI and data governance, SW development, major IT transformations, customer project execution, organizational maturity at small / mid-size entities, sustainability reporting or new digital products and business models.
To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe int the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, training and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world. This is your chance to build your network within the company and become part of a truly international and innovative team.
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is your place to thrive, challenge the status quo, make a difference and grow in a team of pioneers who share your passion for technology.
Discover more about CF A: Siemens Controlling and Finance Assurance (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)
You’ll make an impact by:- Identify and assess key risks across Siemens Financial Services / Siemens Bank, including digital environments, IT transformation programs, and evolving business models.- Lead end-to-end audit engagements (e.g., regulatory annual audits and project-accompanying audits) across various IT topics.- Design and execute risk-based audit programs and control assessments to address identified exposures.- Drive audit planning, scoping, and budgeting, supported by targeted analyses to identify key organizational risks.- Independently drive assurance objectives, aligning conclusions and actionable recommendations to enable measurable organizational improvements.- Lead stakeholder engagement with auditees and senior management to co-ordinate audit planning, present findings, secure alignment, and drive implementation of recommendations.- Build and maintain a strong internal network across Siemens businesses and functions to strengthen audit impact and collaboration.- Challenge and enhance audit methodologies, leveraging AI, automation, and data analytics to increase audit effectiveness and efficiency.- Promote and develop digital audit use cases in partnership with data analytics teams to expand coverage and deepen assurance insights.- Collaborate effectively with external auditors to ensure coordinated, efficient, and high-quality audit execution- Execute audits in accordance with CF A’s Agile Audit Framework.

This is how you'll win us over:- Education & Experience:- Proven track record of career development including  7+ years  of professional experience in a financial services or IT function within Siemens, an IT organization of a regulated financial institution or alternatively in a financial services practice of a ‘Big 4’ / leading consulting firm. - Strong academic history with a degree ideally in Banking, IT, Business or Engineering.

- Expertise & Skills: - Comprehensive IT risk expertise, including general IT controls audits and IT governance across diverse IT infrastructures such as Cloud environments,  ERP systems, operating systems, databases, networks and security tools. Experienced knowledge in auditing AI is advantageous.- Detailed knowledge of process-oriented audit approaches in accordance with current standards (e.g. IDW, DIIR) as well as relevant frameworks (CobiT, ITIL) and regulatory requirements (MaRisk, BaFin, BaIT, DORA, EBA and MAS).- Strong desire and drive to develop into a business or functional role after 3-5 years in audit.- Understanding of IT risk management and assurance principles, along with basic logic programming is beneficial. - Excellent communication skills to summarize and describe audit results.- Professional certification e.g. CISA, CISSP, or in COBIT, ITIL is an advantage.
- Languages: Fluency in English, German is a plus. - Additional: Flexibility to travel (up to 20%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.

As part of our team, you will have: - A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week. - Attractive remuneration package and relocation support (if needed).- CF A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth.- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family.- Access to employee share plans.

Since each of over 300,000 employees feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) . The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.occupation: PCB Layouter (m/f/x) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Lawo, based in Rastatt, Germany, is an innovative, leading supplier of professional audio, video and control solutions to the world-wide broadcast market. We develop and manufacture our products in Germany and support them with a global Customer Support Team.

GROW WITH US! To strengthen our team, we have an immediate opening for a PCB Layouter (m/f/x)   

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

With a focus on high-speed PCB layout for embedded and FPGA-based systems, you will develop sophisticated hardware platforms for the professional audio and video broadcast industry while working closely with our in-house production team.

- Design and develop complex multilayer PCBs for FPGA- and embedded-based systems
- Create high-speed layouts for FPGA interfaces, including: - DDR3 / DDR4 / LPDDR memory interfaces
- High-speed SerDes interfaces (e.g., SDI, HDMI, DisplayPort, Ethernet)
- LVDS, MIPI, PCIe, and USB
- Collaborate closely with FPGA and embedded software/hardware development teams
- Work directly with our in-house production team on: - Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA)
- Manufacturing processes, PCB assembly, and testability
- Optimize PCB layouts for volume production, manufacturability, and product quality
- Perform and evaluate Signal Integrity and Power Integrity simulations
- Define PCB stack-ups, layer structures, controlled impedances, and power distribution concepts
- Ensure compliance with EMC, ESD, and reliability requirements
- Prepare and maintain manufacturing, assembly, and test documentation
- Support prototype bring-up, hardware debugging, and transition to volume production

YOUR PROFILE

- Degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable qualification
- Several years of experience in PCB layout design for FPGA- and embedded-based systems
- Strong knowledge of high-speed PCB design principles, including: - DDR Routing
- Differential pair routing
- Length matching
- Return path optimization
- Proficiency with PCB design tools (experience with Cadence Allegro is preferred)
- Experience with SI and PI simulation tools (e.g., Ansys SIwave and AEDT/HFSS, or equivalent)
- Solid understanding of FPGA architectures, I/O banks, clocking, and power distribution concepts
- Experience collaborating closely with manufacturing and production teams is highly desirable
- Knowledge of broadcast, video, or professional audio systems is an advantage
- Structured, quality-focused working style with strong communication skills
- Excellent English language skills; German and additional languages are considered an advantage

OUR OFFER

- The opportunity to develop high-end FPGA-based systems for the professional broadcast industry
- Close collaboration between engineering and our in-house production team, enabling fast decision-making and efficient development processes
- A high level of ownership and influence over design quality, manufacturability, and production readiness
- A modern development environment with state-of-the-art measurement and test equipment
- Flexible working hours in a hybrid work model
- Global teamwork with more than 30 nationalities
- Taking ownership and responsibility instead of simply executing tasks
- Straightforward collaboration on an equal footing
- Corporate health management
- Lawo Academy: language courses and other professional development opportunities
- Technical equipment for mobile and remote working
- Access to a wide range of employee discounts
- Additional financial benefits
- E-bike leasing
- Charging stations for electric vehicles
- Daily meal options with a wide selection of dishes
- Ample parking spaces directly on site
- A workplace surrounded by nature, providing the perfect environment for active breaks
- Employee events
- Foosball table and a band rehearsal room

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Investigator / (Senior) Investigation Lawyer (m/f/d) at Allianz SE (Senioren-Assistent/in)
jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Compliance - Investigations
About the role

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

How can you make an impact?

As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:

Investigations

- Member of the rapid-reaction task force to lead investigations on ad hoc Compliance issues
- Assess, prioritize, execute and lead complex compliance investigations
- Collaborate with Regions / Global Lines / other entities on delegated investigations
- Provide expert guidance and support to Compliance Officers at local, regional and global levels
- Monitor, follow-up and escalate issues as necessary, ensuring resolution and compliance
- Make effective use of investigative technology and, as it is introduced, AI-enabled methods (e.g. e-discovery, data analytics) to work efficiently and at scale, keeping human judgment at the centre
- Continuously enhance and share insights and lessons learned

Governance

- Develop and implement governance frameworks to support effective investigation processes
Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards
Contribute to the further development of the investigations operating model, including the responsible integration of technology and AI as the setup matures  *  Provide guidance on governance issues related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to enhance organizational integrity

Awareness

- Contribute to initiatives aimed at elevating the awareness and effectiveness of the Whistleblowing program

Reporting

- Ensure comprehensive and accurate data entry into the Compliance Case Management Tool (CCMT)
- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management
- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Fulfill obligations under the Integrity Committee Terms of Reference (both ad hoc and standing committees)
- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Solid experience (3+ years) and proven competence in conducting and, increasingly, leading complex investigations effectively and efficiently, ideally with international exposure
- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

- In-depth knowledge of the insurance business is an advantage
- Some practical, operational experience with investigative technology - e.g. e-discovery, data analytics, IT forensics or legal-tech tools - whether gained as an investigator, IT-forensics specialist or legal-technology professional
- Interest in helping build an AI-enabled investigation capability, with a pragmatic and responsible view of where technology adds real value;
- Strong communication and report-writing skills (fluent English required; additional languages a plus)
- Results-driven team player
- Willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally
- Strategic and innovative approach to working in a governance function
- High level of confidentiality and discretion
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

To learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process

Apply before: 28 September- Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to withdraw the posting prior to the advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
In case of questions reach out to Ms. Isabelle Ebel: +49 160 743 8135

Welcome to Allianz SE!
We at Allianz SE are recognized as a trusted partner for protecting and growing your most valuable assets, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, including property and casualty insurance, life and health insurance, and asset management services, tailored to meet the various needs of individual and corporate clients worldwide. From our international headquarters, we orchestrate global operations, set strategic directions, and ensure cohesive implementation across our international subsidiaries. jobs.description:
Who are weAs a biotechnology company, at Insempra we don’t simply hope for a better future – we actively work to create one.For far too long, companies have relied on chemical production processes, depleting our planet’s limited resources in the process. That’s why our mission is to create a world built on naturally high-quality products and to help restore the balance between people and our planet.
On our journey towards a better future, we are currently supported by a team of more than 40 dedicated people bringing together scientific, entrepreneurial and visionary expertise. But one important person is still missing: you!
We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer – Bioprocess & Equipment (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible at our site on the IZB Campus in Munich/Martinsried.
We offer:
• A central technical role in building out a new production platform from the ground up
• Direct influence on process and equipment design decisions
• Close collaboration with an experienced, interdisciplinary team of around 12 people
• Room to grow the role toward team leadership as the group scales
• A dynamic, science-driven environment in the Munich biotech ecosystem
• You’ll become part of a dynamic start-up creating real value for both the environment and society.
• You’ll take on a responsible role with plenty of room to shape and develop your area.
• You’ll work in an international team with an open feedback culture, flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes.
• 30 days of annual leave (based on full-time employment).
• Flexible working hours.
• Fresh fruit and vegetables as well as free drinks.
• Regular team events.

For this position you will perform the following duties:
• Design and maintain P&IDs for process and downstream equipment
• Specify, select and procure process equipment; manage vendor quotations and technical evaluations
• Plan and oversee equipment installation, commissioning and qualification
• Act as the primary technical contact for external partners - equipment vendors and engineering firms
• Translate process development results into scalable, robust and safe production processes
• Collaborate closely with strain engineering, downstream processing, manufacturing and QA/regulatory teams
• Support HSE and ATEX-relevant risk assessments for process and equipment design
• Contribute to technical documentation, SOPs and process descriptions for internal use and external partners
• Support process development for new and existing microbial production processes, applying a working knowledge of fermentation to prepare processes for implementation
• Contribute to process control strategy for batch and fed-batch processes

Your profile:
• Degree in bioprocess engineering, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field
• 10+ years of hands-on experience in bioprocess development and scale-up
• Proven experience creating P&IDs and specifying process equipment
• Track record of equipment procurement, installation and commissioning in a lab, pilot or production environment
• Confident interfacing with external engineering firms and equipment suppliers
• Structured, hands-on and solution-oriented working style, comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment
• Working knowledge of fermentation process control, automation and instrumentation
• Fluent English; German is a plus
